text: Linux Electron. Simulated Gerrit data and latency. All five files start reviewed.
Click one checkmark. Watch all five status icons during the refresh. Read delay: 600 ms.
One file changed. The other four checkmarks disappeared, then returned.
Reset the first file to reviewed before the rapid-click test.
Click three files 200 ms apart. Fast input is required here. Write delay: 900 ms.
Only the first click was saved. The next two files still have checkmarks.
